source_window.dataset: OS OpenMap Local — SX 100 km tile GeoPackage download

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public OS OpenMap Local ImportantBuilding feature for Exeter from the SX 100 km GeoPackage tile, with physical building Polygon geometry and record-bound classification/distinctiveName evidence. The official Ordnance Survey OpenData download channel publishes OpenMap Local as downloadable 100 km tiles and supports GeoPackage delivery, but the distinct SX download payload could not be read through the available web channel and direct network resolution of api.os.uk failed before any tile or feature record was retrieved; therefore no individual building record was accepted and no geometry or attributes were inferred.
